title: Tabula Nautica, Hessel Gerritsz 1612, in the Hakluyt Society facsimile
creator: Hessel Gerritsz
description: The Hakluyt Society's 1860 lithographic facsimile of Gerritsz's chart of Hudson's discoveries, folded as a frontispiece to Asher's volume. It labels the new inland sea "Mare Magnum de M. Hudson", names Fretum Davis and Groenlandia, and carries the royal arms with the motto DIEU EST MON DROIT, four compass roses and a fleet under sail. This is the map that first put Hudson Bay before European readers.

title: Tabula Geographica: a north polar chart in Purchas's Divers Voyages
creator: engraver unnamed
description: A north polar projection with the pole at the centre and the meridians radiating from it, showing Groenlandia, Nova Zembla, Europe and the north-west, reproduced in Asher's volume at the head of the section of Divers Voyages and Northerne Discoveries.
